members.name: SystemGroup
members.summary: Creates a group from named systems. The first enabled entry starts active; register the others with `enabled: false`.
members.summaryText: Creates a group from named systems. The first enabled entry starts active; register the others with enabled: false.

members.name: Active
members.summary: The running system, or null when none is.
members.summaryText: The running system, or null when none is.

members.name: ActiveIdx
members.summary: Index of the running system, or -1 when none is.
members.summaryText: Index of the running system, or -1 when none is.

members.name: ActiveName
members.summary: Name of the running system, or null when none is.
members.summaryText: Name of the running system, or null when none is.

members.name: Name
members.summary: Name shown in the System Inspector, such as `"Upscaling"`.

members.name: Names
members.summary: Every entry's name, in order. Handy for a dropdown.

members.name: DisableActive
members.summary: Turns the running system off and leaves the group with none active.
members.summaryText: Turns the running system off and leaves the group with none active.

members.name: ForEach
members.summary: Runs an action on every system in the group, active or not.
members.summaryText: Runs an action on every system in the group, active or not.

members.name: IndexOf
members.summary: Returns a system's index in the group, or -1.

members.name: SetActive
members.summary: Switches to the system at an index.

members.name: Toggle
members.summary: Switches to the next system. After the last one, everything is off; toggling again starts over.

summary: A set of interchangeable systems where at most one runs at a time, such as alternative upscalers. Switching disposes the old system and initializes the new one.
